review:
The sequel to Wazdan's bell jackpot game, on 12 reels with two bonus rounds instead of one. Hold the Jackpot is still here, with sticky Cash Infinity symbols adding to its value.

The new part is the 12 Bells Bonus Game, where one click can award several prizes, and One Click 2 Grand can hand you the Grand Jackpot directly. Chance Level makes both bonuses more likely. The Grand is a modest 750x, with high volatility and a 96.15% RTP. Better for frequent small bonus moments than chasing a huge prize.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
